name: @dudousxd/nestjs-catalog-telescope
description: Telescope watcher and "Catalog" dashboard for @dudousxd/nestjs-catalog: loads, connector runs, schema changes and curation edits, grouped by the snapshot that correlates them.
author: Davide Carvalho
//sideEffects: Safe to be false: nothing here runs at import time. The watcher subscribes to diagnostics channels only inside register(), and every other export is a pure declaration or a factory. Lets a host tree-shake the providers it does not render.
//engines: 22, not 20. This package emits CommonJS (matching @dudousxd/nestjs-catalog's tsconfig, so both compile identically inside a host) while @dudousxd/nestjs-telescope and @dudousxd/nestjs-diagnostics are ESM-only, so loading it needs require(esm) — stable from Node 22.
